description: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/helpers.rs is: 'pub(crate) use jmap_server::{extract_account_id, not_found_json, now_utc_string, ser};'. This adds a module that does nothing but rename the import path. Callers inside chat-server use 'crate::helpers::{...}' while mail-server similarly re-exports from jmap_server. Both crates have this pattern. It is not harmful but it is a noise file that confuses new contributors who open it expecting to find implementations. If the re-export is retained, it should at minimum have a doc comment explaining why it exists (to allow future chat-specific helpers to live here). If no such helpers are planned, import directly from jmap_server.
title: chat-server helpers.rs is a one-liner re-export — adds confusion without adding abstraction
